text:
Monica P.: Heads up team - ACME security wants our SOC 2 report and an interim assurance note so procurement can greenlight the POC next week. They also want a named custodian for any artifacts.
Rahul S.: Do they need the entire report PDF or is a redacted extract acceptable?
Monica P.: They said full report preferred but will accept redacted diagrams. Their vendor team requires auditable transfer of any evidence.
Katie L.: Legal prefers we avoid emailing raw logs. Proposal: NDA first, then a time-limited S3 share with CloudTrail and role-based read-only access. Also provide a redaction manifest.
Legal Bot: Correct. Use standard-sales-nda-v3. For interim assurance (bridge) letters, Legal Privileged must approve signatory and wording. Provide scope and delivery ETA.
Rahul S.: I can be the engineering custodian. Scope requested: inference runtime and control plane only. ETA: full SOC 2 artifact package available 4 business days after NDA execution.
Sales Ops: I can generate the presigned access flow and coordinate ops. Will we include a checksum for the PDF?
Monica P.: Yes include sha256 and we should send checksum in a separate signed email after NDA return.
Katie L.: Redaction checklist: remove internal hostnames, customer PII, and internal diagrams that show non-customer IP. Legal, confirm that's fine.
Legal Bot: Confirmed. Maintain a redaction log (fields removed and reason). Bridge letter must reference the scope and state that full artifacts will be provided under NDA within the ETA.
ACME Security Bot: Thanks, please ensure access is time-limited (<= 7 days) and IP access is restricted to listed reviewer IPs if possible.
Rahul S.: We can restrict by presigned URL + optional IP restriction on the bucket policy. CloudTrail will capture access events. I'll document the custodian acceptance form.
Sales Ops: Action items for me: 1) Send NDA template to ACME now (cc Legal) 2) Prepare presigned bucket and policy draft 3) Add redaction manifest template. Will update when NDA sent.
Monica P.: Perfect. Once NDA is signed, Sales Ops grant read-only access to the presigned objects, Legal confirm bridge wording, and Rahul confirms custodian handoff. Ping here when NDA signed so I can lock POC date. :white_check_mark:
file_notes: POC kickoff in 1 week, includes NDA -> presigned S3 flow and interim bridge letter coordination.
